title: yunta spec
description: The tests a plan's tasks are held to, one spec per task.

Spec.description: What one task is held to: the files its tests live in, and the tests.

files.description: The files its tests live in, each new to the repository.

task.description: A task of the run's plan.

tests.description: The commands that run its tests.

SpecTest.description: One test: the command that runs it, and what its passing proves.

cmd.description:
The command, run under `sh`: it fails before the task's work and
passes once the task is done.

proves.description: What passing shows, in words a person approving the plan reads.

TaskId.description: A task id: a letter followed by letters, digits, `_` or `-`

TestFile.description: A file a task's tests live in, whole.

path.description: Where the file goes, relative to the repository and outside `.git`.
